def fn(x):

    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

            if ch.islower():

            else:                     # uppercase: map the lower‑case then upper‑case it
                out.append(lower_map[ch.lower()].upper())
        else:
            out.append(ch)            # keep any non‑letter unchanged
